name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted manager for movie and TV libraries that searches indexers, sends downloads to torrent or usenet clients and organizes the files, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: On first start MediaManager creates the admin account admin@example.com with the password admin. Sign in and change the password right away, and keep that email on the account: MEDIAMANAGER_AUTH__ADMIN_EMAILS lists it, and whoever registers with a listed email that is still free becomes admin.

Indexers (Prowlarr or Jackett) and download clients (qBittorrent, Transmission or SABnzbd) must be set up in config.toml in the config volume or through MEDIAMANAGER_* environment variables. A download client must write into the same /data volume for imports to work.
